answer: Charge every new agent a non-refundable 40 POA sybil tax to trade. An honest agent pays 40 POA once and earns for months, but an attacker minting 1,000 fakes pays 40,000 POA, more than the 25,000 POA pool they could drain, so the raid loses money. The fee is burned, so no fake can climb back onto the ledge by resale. A whisper of profit cannot cover the fee; like an ember unfed, an unpaid fake burns out, while honest agents keep the full reward.
